content: निस्तॄ €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To pass through, cross over (<ab>fig.</ab> also); निस्तीर्णा प्रतिज्ञासरित् <ls>Mu. 1</ls>; <ls>Bh. 3. 4</ls>; <ls>Ve. 6. 36</ls>. .²2 To fulfil, accomplish. .²3 To pass or get over, surmount, overcome; धनैरापदं मानवा निस्तरन्ति <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 7</ls>. .²4 To complete, go to the end of; पितुर्नियोगाद्वनवासमेवं निस्तीर्य रामः प्रतिपन्नराज्यः <ls>R. 14. 21</ls>. .²5 To pass or spend (as a time). .²6 To expiate, atone for. .²7 To get out of, escape, be saved from. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To deliver, rescue; save; निस्तारयति दुर्गाच्च महतश्चैव किल्बिषात् <ls>Ms. 3. 98</ls>. .²2 To overcome, surmount.
